mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM assessment_indicator WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id = 0 THEN id ELSE parent_id END, parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 END) as activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN indicator_type = 1 THEN 1 END) as quantitativeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN indicator_type = 2 THEN 1 END) as qualitativeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id = 0 THEN 1 END) as rootCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN weight ELSE 0 END), 4) as totalWeight FROM assessment_indicator
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_indicator WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_active = 1

SELECT ai.id, ai.indicator_name, COUNT(ad.id) as usageCount, MAX(pa.assessment_date) as lastUsedDate FROM assessment_indicator ai LEFT JOIN assessment_detail ad ON ai.id = ad.indicator_id LEFT JOIN project_assessment pa ON ad.assessment_id = pa.id WHERE ai.id = #{indicatorId} GROUP BY ai.id, ai.indicator_name
